name: Bubble v0.1.2
body:
Fixes:
- The + marker no longer lands alone at the start of a wrapped chat line; it now wraps with the last word.
- The reaction picker opens next to your cursor and stays on screen, including near the right and bottom edges.
- The picker no longer blocks typing or clicking elsewhere. It closes on its own after 10 seconds without the mouse over it, on Escape, or when you pick an icon.

**Install:** unzip so you have `Interface/AddOns/Bubble/Bubble.toc`, then restart the client. See the README for features.
